name: Sneevel
description: Sneevels were a fur-covered sentient species. Boles Roor was a Sneevel Podracer pilot from the world of Sneeve who competed in at least three Boonta Eve Classic Podraces, two of which the pilot had won. A more infamous Sneevel was the Garel City crime lord Skraik, who operated in the years before the Galactic Civil War.
